text.tspan: OpenZGY will combine the Accessor, File, and Version layers and simplify
them considerably. The drawback is that changes to the format will cause
more ripple effects. There will be just a single API exposed to clients, and
a single internal API which will change if or when changes are made to the
file format. Support for compression and cloud I/O will not be present initially.
